title: AuroraWorld: Structured 4D World Modeling for Exo-to-Ego Video Generation in Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.00177v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Egocentric observations provide a robot-centric view of manipulation processes, capturing contact interactions and object-state changes that are important for visuomotor policy learning but difficult to observe from external cameras. However, collecting such data at scale remains expensive due to additional hardware requirements and platform-specific deployment costs. Synthesizing egocentric observations from large-scale exocentric manipulation videos provides a scalable alternative. However, existing methods struggle to synthesize physically consistent and policy-relevant egocentric videos under substantial viewpoint transformations, severe occlusions, complex object interactions, and inherently sparse observations from available exocentric viewpoints.Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/xueha0/AuroraWorld

translated_title: AuroraWorld：面向机器人操作中外部视角到第一人称视角视频生成的结构化4D世界建模
translated_abstract: 第一人称（自我中心）观测提供了以机器人为中心的操作过程视角，能够捕捉到对视觉运动策略学习至关重要、但难以从外部相机观察到的接触交互和物体状态变化。然而，由于需要额外的硬件设备以及特定平台的部署成本，大规模收集此类数据仍然十分昂贵。从大规模的外部视角操作视频中合成第一人称观测提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。然而，在面临大幅度的视角变换、严重的遮挡、复杂的物体交互以及外部视角固有的稀疏观测时，现有方法难以合成物理一致且与策略学习相关的第一人称视频。代码将在 https://github.com/xueha0/AuroraWorld 公开。
tldr: 提出AuroraWorld，一种结构化4D世界建模方法，能够从大规模外部视角机器人操作视频中合成物理一致、且对视觉运动策略学习有用的第一人称视角视频。
en_tdlr: AuroraWorld introduces a structured 4D world modeling framework that synthesizes physically consistent and policy-relevant egocentric videos from large-scale exocentric robot manipulation videos.
